title: Poster
description: A still from the Blender Studio film Charge, screen-printed as a campaign poster in four flat inks with striped mid-tones and wobbling hand-cut edges. Move the exposure and a squeegee pulls a fresh print over the old one, row by row; change the inks or type your own word and it re-pulls again.
intent: Print as a physical act: the poster is never recoloured, it is re-printed. Every row of the sheet keeps the exposure and inks it got when the squeegee passed, and each pull lands a little off register.
